# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old when first introduced
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is fair with long, sleek yellow curls that never get out of order. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a prim mouth.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is quiet, prim, timid, and exceptionally well-behaved. She behaves politely at the table, submits calmly to authority, and refrains from participating in bad behavior. Unlike her twin brother, she is reserved and cautious, though she easily becomes frightened by dark rooms or scary stories.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P3](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0003), [v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003)_

## Traits

- Quiet and well-behaved  <sub>[v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)</sub>
- Timid  <sub>[v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003)</sub>
- Fear of the dark and ghost stories  <sub>[v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)</sub>

## History

Following the illness and death of her mother Mary Keith, Dora and her twin brother Davy were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert to live at Green Gables. She quickly proved to be a quiet, polite, and prim child, in contrast to her mischievous twin brother. Upon starting school, she sat with Mirabel Cotton, who frightened her with stories of deceased relatives walking about houses. On another occasion, her brother Davy locked her in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and lied about her whereabouts until Anne Shirley rescued her. As she grew up at Green Gables, Dora maintained her polite, moral demeanour and refused to associate with unruly children like the Cottons.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), [v2 c10 P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c21 P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)_

- Daughter of Mary Keith, a third cousin to Marilla Cuthbert  <sub>[v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013)</sub>
